integrity.code: verify.py (standalone Python standard-library numerical spot checks)
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic concavity-under-group-averaging, exact Fourier concave-endpoint reduction, exhaustive affine-envelope minimax, and elementary asymptotics.

scientific_limitations: Applies to undirected symmetric continuous-time dynamics on the square of a cycle with n>=5 and fixed class prices; no arbitrary graph or Markov transition-rate constraint is included.
The complete optimizer classification concerns edge-class-uniform allocations. Nonuniform global optimizers are not classified.
Numerical tests are finite consistency checks, not exhaustive proofs or independent audit.
A wider literature search or equivalent reformulation could alter the assessment of historical novelty.
title: Exact price phases for two-hop consensus on cyclic networks
